changes.comment: ImageMapLayerSettings: `savedQueryParams` is renamed `queryParams` (matching the persisted JSON property; the old name remains as a deprecated accessor over the same value) and `unsavedQueryParams` is deprecated - inject secret or per-session parameters through a map-layer fetch handler (MapLayerFormatRegistry.addMapLayerFetchHandler in @itwin/core-frontend) instead. Both keep working until removed in the next major version.
